facts.statement: Inside the striatum, dorsal and ventral astrocyte groups match specific neural circuits, with a ventral group found in the nucleus accumbens shell, a pattern also seen in nonhuman primates.

facts.statement: A deep learning model was used to find specific genetic codes for each astrocyte subgroup and recover transcription factor logic from existing data to help design targeted viral vectors.
